name: 霧翼梟
subject: A MIST-WING OWL, complete large owl, muted grey-brown feathers with pale cream face disk and chest, amber eyes, full articulated wings, two taloned legs and short tail.

name: 根鬚守望者
subject: A ROOT WHISKER WATCHER, full tall dry root humanoid with a broad elder tree face, long branching root beard attached to chest, two clawlike branch arms and two root feet, sage-green lichen and tan bark.

name: 翠風妖狐
subject: An EMERALD WIND FOX, full slender fox with complete four legs, a broad flowing single tail curling inward, rust-brown and cream fur with restrained jade-green markings and pale teal eyes.

name: 千年森靈
subject: A MILLENNIAL FOREST SPIRIT, complete sturdy ancient wooden guardian with a crown of short gnarled branches, ivory bark face, warm dark wood torso, two arm-like boughs and two root legs; moss, a few gold leaves.
